notes: somatic core 1.5.0: a model takes its turn while it reads, exactly where it predicts it (force read on waits for a real turn), then goes back to the file. its two skills, search and run: where its most likely next token opens a file, it gets one: a page it has a link to, search results, or what its code printed. the crawler follows only links the model has read, reaches only public addresses, honours robots.txt and is capped per turn and per hour; run is python in a sandbox with no network, installed separately. checkpoints are unchanged: every somatic core model opens.
